data.summary: Gartencenter Beispielblüte sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) stating that no payment was received for the delivery and planting of 6 fruit trees on 22 October 2026, and asks for the outstanding total of €537.00 (including a €3.00 reminder fee) to be paid by 4 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a payment reminder from the garden center that planted trees in your garden in October. According to them, the original invoice was never paid, so they added a small reminder fee and now ask for the full amount, €537.00, to be transferred by the date shown. If you already paid, the letter says you can simply ignore it. There is no legal remedy procedure here — it's a private business reminder, not a court order — but if the amount stays unpaid, further reminders or fees could follow, so check your bank records and pay by the deadline if the charge is correct.
data.tax_note: The planting work performed at your home may qualify as a deductible craftsman service (Handwerkerleistung) under §35a EStG; keep this document and the corresponding invoice for your tax return.
